results.name: Relentless: choose source Hero -> hand EXP -> resolves
Relentless: immediately rank up Hero at EXP 300
Normal Event: refuse to play when no legal source
Scouting: two Hero selections plus EXP target
Dazed: Event source + opponent target -> Stun
Greater Health Potion: target already exhausted -> +50
Elixir: choose allied status target -> cleanses
Phoenix Feather: choose defeated Hero -> revive at 10 HP
Freeze Bomb: choose opponent Hero -> Freeze
No heal without damaged Hero; no Freeze target without opponent
AI Item Heal: never missing target; no Hero source for Item
AI Event action needs a source Hero and opponent target
